authority.director_trigger: Director said continue after the exact-full-raster integration HOLD and recommended bounded Stage-presentation successor.

question: Can a pixel-preserving Stage-field presentation remove obsolete embedded application chrome while preserving all frozen five-Character Stage meanings and integrating cleanly with the completed shell?

candidates.purpose: Control whether one rectangle can preserve all five cone units without carrying unacceptable embedded legacy chrome.

candidates.kind: exact-pixel crop plus transparent authority notch
candidates.purpose: Remove only the upper-left inherited Live Performance strip fragment that geometrically overlaps the rectangle required to preserve Marlowe and Wren. Retained pixels remain byte-for-byte pixel values from the frozen master.

coordinate_basis: One disposable 100px coordinate-grid overlay of the frozen master was used only to locate legacy-chrome and frozen-carrier boundaries. It is not candidate evidence and coordinates are frozen before candidate materialization.
frozen_meaning_requirements: all five Character cone/floor/name/state units remain materially complete
shared dark Stage floor remains visible
causal-field background remains subordinate to cone/floor hierarchy
must_remove_or_avoid: embedded Production/Scene labels when the completed shell already supplies current scope
provisional right rail / Live Summary / Active Tensions / Observed Cues
partial UI fragments that read as active controls or navigation
mechanical_law: Source hash, byte size and 1672x941 dimensions must verify before extraction.
Crop uses integer pixel coordinates only; no resize, interpolation, filtering or color transform is permitted.
For S1, RGB values of every retained pixel must exactly equal the corresponding source pixel; the only changed channel is alpha=0 inside the preregistered notch.
Derived candidate PNGs are disposable/Drive evidence and are not committed as new canonical Stage masters.
Light F2 and Dark D3 must use identical candidate pixels.
No external resources may be required by the review carrier.
falsifiers: Any frozen cone/floor/name/state unit is clipped or made materially less legible.
Any legacy embedded chrome remains and competes with the completed shell.
The transparent notch reads as a conspicuous missing block or damages Stage depth.
The extraction makes the Stage feel like a decorative thumbnail rather than the dominant live-work field.
Light/Dark shell context changes Stage meaning.
Any Product-open transcript/action/rail semantics are implicitly promoted by presentation.
selection_law: A candidate may be selected only if it survives mechanical checks and recursive visual falsification without result-aware coordinate or mask changes. If both survive materially, stop for Director taste. If neither survives, close HOLD and recommend a separately authorized rebuilt Stage presentation asset.
non_authority: No PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 replacement or Stage semantic successor is created by method activation.
No cone redesign, new background generation, inpainting, repaint, recolor, typography change or Product command semantics are authorized.
No production token, WinUI/XAML, native accessibility, shipping or Store authority is created.
